newsitem.title: UK: Ibstock sees sharply lower 1996 profits.
newsitem.headline: Ibstock sees sharply lower 1996 profits.

text.p: Building materials and paper products group Ibstock Plc said on Wednesday it expects pre-tax profits for 1996 to be "significantly less than for 1995."

The company, which is the latest British building materials group to report disappointing interim results, said in a statement that based on forecasts for pulp prices its does not expect half-year losses at the division to be recovered by the end of the year.
Ibstock reported a plunge in interim pretax profits to 2.4 million stg from 14 milllion stg.
